body: In `molt_condition_breakdown` (shrimp.rs:1427), the condition-vs-reserve weights `0.75` and `0.25` are hardcoded: `(0.75 * condition_index.clamp(0.0, 1.0) + 0.25 * reserve_factor)`. Similarly, the `reserve_factor` lower bound of `0.4` (line 1421) is hardcoded. These directly shape molt success probability. Consider promoting at least the condition/reserve split weights to named parameters so the relative importance of body condition vs. energy reserves can be tuned without code changes.
